meta.title: Mae Bio Inspirations: Ant Colony Social Immunity

chunks.title: Social Immunity Biology
chunks.content: Five mechanisms of ant colony social immunity: 1) Allogrooming - ants groom infected nestmates with antimicrobial compounds (60% formic acid), kills 96% of spores, preferentially targets highly-infectious individuals. 2) Low-dose social immunization - healthy groomers pick up sub-lethal pathogen dose, triggering individual immunity; ALL colony members gain resistance through social contact; pathogen-specific memory. 3) Organizational immunity - age-based task segregation (young inside, old foraging outside), spatial quarantine, network restructuring under threat. 4) Waste management partitioning - dedicated waste workers isolated from brood-tenders. 5) Altruistic self-sacrifice - fatally infected pupae emit chemical signal triggering own destruction.

chunks.title: Social Immunity Computational Model
chunks.content: Markovian model (Vrabac 2024): States S(susceptible), E(exposed), I(infectious), R(immunized), D(removed). Transitions: S->E (pathogen contact), E->I (load exceeds immune capacity), E->R (grooming reduces to sub-lethal = immunization), I->R (intensive grooming clears), I->D (overwhelmed + sacrifice), S->R (social vaccination via grooming contact). Colony parameters: grooming rate (scales with pathogen load), grooming effectiveness (scales with groomer priming), social network density (modifiable), spatial segregation index.

chunks.title: Social Immunity Mae Architecture Mapping
chunks.content: Proposed SocialImmunity in defense/ module. Grooming = agents inspect/clean peers with validation capabilities. Immunization = share weakened threat signatures colony-wide via KnowledgeBase. Organizational immunity = topology restructuring via MycelialSubstrate. Quarantine = isolated substrate partitions. Sacrifice = graceful shutdown of compromised agents. Integrates with HAVEN (extends to response), ThreatDetector (orchestrates collective response), MycelialSubstrate (restructuring), AutoHealer (proactive vs reactive), EndocrineSystem (cortisol->restructuring, oxytocin->grooming), KnowledgeBase (threat memory), FRL (defense policy sharing), QuorumSensor (consensus for quarantine/sacrifice). Novel: herd immunity through distributed social contact.
